name: Hanasaki Mahiro
source:
A college freshman who doesn't back down.
She's also good at sucking up to her seniors, and she knows how much the nerds of the club go for her petite figure.
Loves to be fussed over as the center of attention.

[from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375190/Queen_of_the_Otaku_THERE_CAN_ONLY_BE_ONE/]Steam[/url]]
